title: Nine Feet of Timber
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：branch　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 branch 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother was sent to cut ① a branch she could not reach, and she said the reaching was the whole of the lesson. The ② branch, meaning the limb and not the tree, was nine feet long and was carried by whoever came last; a branch, she said, is the only thing in a wood that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ branch in that wood had the same moss, and the ④ branch at the top, meaning the one the keeper sawed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly. A branch, my grandmother said, is nine parts timber and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the timber is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ branch was the whole of the river, meaning the stream it carried and not the limb. The ⑥ branch, meaning the river and not any of that, is the only thing in a valley that everybody follows and nobody questions; a branch, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both a limb and a river. She said the river is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ branch had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the timber. The ⑧ branch of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine feet of timber and eleven years of reaching; a branch, she said, is either the one at the top or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ branch I remember is the one at the top, which was pruned in 1973 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ branch, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being pruned; every branch, she said, is a river that has agreed to look like a limb. She said the river was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 树枝（指那根枝本身，与整棵树相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut a branch 砍下一根树枝
D. n. 树枝（指林子里每一根）
E. n. 树枝（指树顶那一根）
F. n. 支流；分支（抽象：与树枝相对）
G. n. 那条支流（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a branch she could not reach
The branch, meaning the limb and not the tree
branch was the whole of the river
the branch had become a photograph in a report
The branch of the whole thing
A branch, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: cut a branch 意为“砍下一根树枝”，1949 年母亲被派去砍一根她够不着的树枝。
branch 意为“树枝”，指那根枝本身而不是整棵树，长九英尺，由最后走的人扛走。
branch 指林子里每一根树枝，每一根都是同样的苔藓。
branch 指树顶那一根（护林员锯的那一根），是唯一有人认真量过的。
branch 意为“支流、分支”，与树枝相对，父亲说 branch 就是那条河的全部。
branch 为抽象用法，指那条支流本身，是山谷里人人都沿着走、却没人质疑的东西。
branch 意为“树枝、分枝”，到 1967 年这根 branch 成了报告里的一张照片。
branch 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺的木材和十一年的够取。
branch 意为“树枝”，我记得的是树顶那一根，1973 年修剪过，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
branch 为抽象总称，祖母说树枝是唯一会因为被修剪而变好的东西。

The branch at the top, meaning the one the keeper sawed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly.
